unusual_experiment.name: CAUSAL_FAMILY_ID_FORK
unusual_experiment.hypothesis: Two correlated training traces with the same admitted causal ancestry can select different caller-controlled trace_family_id labels and therefore be assigned to different dataset splits.
unusual_experiment.method: Reproduce the exact ENTITYOS_HCU_JSPACE_DATASET_FAMILY_SPLIT/v1 domain-separated SHA-256 bucket rule while holding the causal-origin concept fixed and varying only the free family label.

source_mechanism.training_trace: build_training_trace accepts trace_family_id as a caller-supplied nonempty string and includes it in the self-authenticating trace digest, but does not derive it from causal ancestry.
source_mechanism.dataset_admission: ENTITYOS_HCU_JSPACE_DATASET_ADMISSION/v2 binds generation, Entry, route, GRID, cell, role, basis, vector-control condition and optional verified outcome ancestry, but DatasetAdmission carries no family identity and does not bind trace_family_id.
source_mechanism.family_split: The family splitter hashes the explicit training_trace.trace_family_id and only proves that an already-built trace was not relabelled after registry admission.
source_mechanism.serious_compiler: compile_jspace_bootstrap_dataset_v1 returns the explicit trace_family_id from each validated trace and calls split_for_family on that label; the admitted compiler reuses this lower compiler after separate admission/inference checks.
source_mechanism.counterhypothesis_rejected: Exact trace digest plus admitted-training registry prevents post-admission relabelling, but does not prove that independently constructed correlated traces were assigned the same family label before admission.

impact.benchmark_effect: Held-out quality can be inflated because causal relatives may be partitioned under different aliases.

adjacent_source_drift.finding: The standalone family splitter currently declares DATASET_ADMISSION_SCHEMA v1 while the current dataset admission gate emits v2.
adjacent_source_drift.scope: INTERFACE_DRIFT_SOURCE_FINDING_ONLY; serious compiler imports split_for_family directly, so this is not claimed as proof of serious-pipeline runtime failure.

repair_contract: Family split ownership must come from causally admitted ancestry, not an unconstrained caller label.
Preserve trace_family_id as optional provenance/human grouping only; it must not be the sole split authority.
Use one existing split authority rather than creating a second family service or state authority.
A baseline/lesion/shuffle/rescue set sharing the admitted causal-family anchors must be forced into one split even if their supplied labels differ.
Fail closed on ambiguous family ownership or contradictory causal-family bindings.
Version the split/dataset contract if split semantics change and preserve exact receipt provenance.

required_regression.name: SAME_CAUSAL_ANCESTRY_DIFFERENT_LABELS_ONE_SPLIT_OR_REJECT
required_regression.expected: Two admitted traces sharing the selected stable causal-family anchors but carrying different family labels cannot appear in different train/validation/holdout partitions.
required_regression.execution_gate: Run the fixed regression on the admitted bounded FREE isolated Sandbox surface after exact source/capsule binding; fail closed on quota/billing/upgrade/charge path.

coordination.reason_for_no_core_code_write_in_this_re: The retained HCU donor is hot and materially diverged while main is advancing concurrently; source semantics should be repaired inside PR1263 rather than by creating a second parallel family-split implementation.

next_exact_gate: Repair family ownership inside retained PR1263, add SAME_CAUSAL_ANCESTRY_DIFFERENT_LABELS_ONE_SPLIT_OR_REJECT regression, then execute the same fixed exact-source family-split/admitted-dataset capsule on the bounded FREE Sandbox. In parallel preserve the existing entry-capsule manifest-label repair and extend only after exact component evidence toward route -> verified engine load -> inference -> GRID10 -> J-Space/GWT -> admitted causal dataset closure.
